name: load-more
title: Load More
description: The shared Load more footer for keyset lists — an outline button that keeps its width while loading, an error line with Try again, and an optional end caption.

meta.whenToUse: The footer of a keyset (cursor) list — DataList's or DataGrid's loadMore, a board lane, a feed: load the next batch, retry a failed one, optionally say the list has ended.
meta.whenNotToUse: Numbered pages with a known total (DataListPager); loading on scroll with no button.
